YOUR INFORMATION

A little space for privacy.

Your quiz answers and optional amounts are held in this browser tab. They are not sent to our server or included in analytics. Reloading or starting again clears them.

On the live site, Cloudflare Turnstile receives technical information to check for automated traffic. Our Cloudflare backend validates only its verification token. If you enable optional analytics below, Yandex Metrica records funnel events and campaign parameters, without quiz answers or financial amounts. Analytics is off by default.

Optional analytics

Off. You can take the whole quiz without enabling it.

Opening the App Store takes you to Apple. Answers and amounts are not transferred into the app. You will set up your plan there.
